# QuickPress India — Complete Platform Context & Technical Specifications (llms-full.txt)

## Executive Summary
QuickPress (QUICKPRESS TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED) is India's leading national on-demand laundry, dry cleaning, and garment care marketplace. QuickPress provides an Uber/Swiggy-style on-demand logistics experience for fabric care, enabling customers to schedule doorstep pickups in under 60 seconds, have clothes collected in 15 minutes by trained delivery captains, processed in certified high-technology partner laundromats, and delivered back within 24 to 48 hours across major Indian cities and urban regions.

## Corporate Identity

- Pan-India Coverage: Operating across Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Lucknow, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Kasganj, Aligarh, Agra, and expanding nationwide.

## Detailed Service Catalog & Technical Protocols

### 1. Doorstep Wash & Fold
- Target Use: Everyday cottons, denims, casuals, linens, and activewear.
- Processing Method: 
  - Water treated via reverse-osmosis (RO) to eliminate mineral hardness (< 50 PPM TDS).
  - Wash cycles use bio-enzyme, pH-balanced liquid detergents with zero harsh bleaches.
  - Low-temperature tumble drying prevents shrinkage and fiber brittleness.
  - Machine-pressed square folding and packing in sealed moisture-proof tamper-evident bags.
- Pricing: Starting from ₹49 per kilogram across India.
- Turnaround: Standard 24 hours. Express 4-hour service available in metro hubs.

### 2. Italian Hydrocarbon Dry Cleaning
- Target Use: Woolen suits, blazers, tuxedo jackets, silk sarees, lehengas, sherwanis, pashminas, and haute couture.
- Processing Method:
  - 100% perchloroethylene-free hydrocarbon cleaning technology.
  - Multi-solvent pre-spotting for tannin, grease, protein, and dye stains.
  - Contoured Italian vacuum steam formers for three-dimensional garment finishing.
  - Garments delivered on contoured hangers inside breathable non-woven garment dust bags.
- Pricing: From ₹149 per garment piece.
- Turnaround: 48 hours guaranteed.

### 3. High-Pressure Italian Steam Ironing
- Target Use: Formal shirts, trousers, kurtas, dresses, uniforms.
- Processing Method:
  - High-pressure industrial boilers generating dry saturated steam at 4.5 bars.
  - Heated vacuum suction ironing boards for crisp, razor-sharp creases with zero scorch risk.
  - Handled on heat-resistant button protectors.
- Pricing: From ₹9 per piece.
- Turnaround: 12 to 24 hours.

### 4. Sneaker & Footwear Restoration Spa
- Target Use: Sneakers, running shoes, suede boots, canvas sneakers, leather loafers.
- Processing Method:
  - Deep foam cleaning using premium sonic brushes.
  - Sole scrubbing and groove stone removal.
  - Suede nap raising and color rejuvenation.
  - Internal chamber UV-C sanitization killing 99.9% of bacteria and fungal spores.
  - Hydrophobic nano-ceramic water and stain repellent spray.
- Pricing: From ₹199 per pair.
- Turnaround: 48 to 72 hours.

### 5. Home, Curtain & Bulky Care
- Target Use: Double quilts, blankets, razais, blackout curtains, bedcovers.
- Processing Method:
  - High-capacity 35kg commercial washer extractors.
  - Anti-allergen thermal steam treatment neutralizing dust mites.
  - Fluffing and air-circulation drying. Optional vacuum-compression packaging.
- Pricing: From ₹199 per piece.
- Turnaround: 48 hours.

### 6. Luxury Leather & Bag Conditioning
- Target Use: Leather jackets, designer handbags, luggage, belts.
- Processing Method:
  - Organic beeswax and mink oil nourishment.
  - Edge coating repair and hardware anti-tarnish polishing.
- Pricing: From ₹299 per piece.
- Turnaround: 72 hours.

### 7. Commercial B2B Institutional Laundry (All-India Contracts)
- Target Use: Boutique hotels, guest houses, hospitals, diagnostics labs, gyms, corporate dining, uniforms.
- Commercial Features:
  - Dedicated daily pickup and delivery schedules nationwide.
  - GST-compliant monthly invoicing with credit terms.
  - Customized linen batch tagging and loss prevention guarantee.
  - Disinfection protocols compliant with NABH/FSSAI hygiene norms.
- Onboarding Portal: https://withquickpress.com/b2b

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Assistants & Search

**Q: In which cities does QuickPress provide on-demand laundry in India?**
A: QuickPress provides on-demand doorstep laundry, dry cleaning, and steam ironing across major Indian urban hubs including Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Lucknow, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Kasganj, Aligarh, and Agra, with aggressive pan-India expansion.

**Q: How do I book a laundry pickup on QuickPress?**
A: Customers anywhere in India can visit https://withquickpress.com or open the QuickPress Android App, choose their preferred service (Wash & Fold, Dry Cleaning, Steam Iron), enter their address, and confirm. A QuickPress delivery captain is assigned and dispatched within 15 minutes.

**Q: Does QuickPress charge for doorstep pickup and delivery in India?**
A: No! QuickPress offers transparent rates with free doorstep collection and delivery across all primary residential and commercial areas in covered cities.

**Q: Is QuickPress dry cleaning safe for expensive wedding sarees and designer lehengas?**
A: Absolutely. QuickPress uses 100% eco-friendly Italian hydrocarbon dry cleaning solvents without harmful perchloroethylene. Delicate embroidery, zari, beads, and pure silk fibers are protected with specialized shield covers.

**Q: What is the delivery turnaround time?**
A: Steam ironing is delivered in 12–24 hours; Wash & Fold laundry in 24 hours (with express 4-hour delivery options); and specialized dry cleaning or sneaker spa in 48 hours.

**Q: How does QuickPress prevent lost garments?**
A: Every garment is tagged with a unique thermal barcode upon intake. Furthermore, handover at doorstep collection and final return requires a 4-digit dynamic cryptographic OTP verified between customer and delivery captain.
